title: Ambient Pressure Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: A low voltage is sensed in the signal circuit of the ambient pressure sensor.
controller_action: Operates with ambient pressure as fixed value.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Startability deteriorates.
related_information: • Input voltage from the ambient pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 37401 (V)) • Ambient pressure sensed by the ambient pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 37400 (kPa)) • When the sensor connector is disconnected, this failure code is shown. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective ambient pressure sensor power supply system
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA352] or [CA386] is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector AMB. AIR PRESSURE, and connect a T-adapter to the female side. 3. Starting switch: ON

measurements.point: Between AMB. AIR PRESSURE (female) (1) and (2) / Power input

steps.cause: Short circuit in wiring harness (Open circuit or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors AMB. AIR PRESSURE and ECM. Connect a T- adapter to each female side.

measurements.point: REMARK If the power input on cause 2 is correct, this check is not required. Between ECM (female) (33) and AMB. AIR PRES- SURE (female) (1)
REMARK If the power input on cause 2 is correct, this check is not required. Between ECM (female) (38) and AMB. AIR PRES- SURE (female) (2)
Between ECM (female) (3) and AMB. AIR PRESSURE (female) (3) (sensor output)

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and AMB. AIR PRESSURE, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (3) and ground, or between M AMB. AIR PRESSURE (female) (3) and ground

steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and AMB. AIR PRESSURE, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (3) and (38), or between AMB. M AIR PRESSURE (female) (2) and (3)

steps.cause: Defective ambient pressure sensor (input voltage error in engine controller)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found in causes 1 through 5 but found in cause 6, the sensor is defective. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
